No personalized tax or eligibility determination is made. Every such cell is blank + UNVERIFIED.

flags.title: Exchange rates are a timestamped board snapshot, not a quote
flags.detail: Model rates come from the BOC quotation board read at 2026-11-10 07:32:39 (S07): spot buy 666.22 / sell 669.03 CNY per 100 USD. BOC's board disclaimer states the table is for reference only and actual transaction rates are those executed at BOC channels. All CNY/USD figures in this edition are model outputs at that snapshot.

flags.title: Receiving U.S. bank fee unknown
flags.detail: The destination bank was not identified and no receiving-bank fee schedule is verified in this edition. Incoming international wire fees vary by bank. All receiving-fee cells are blank + UNVERIFIED.

flags.detail: Correspondent banks may deduct undisclosed intermediary fees on USD wires. No official schedule retrieved. Cells blank + UNVERIFIED.

flags.title: Chinese tax on the underlying income unknown
flags.detail: Currency conversion itself is not a taxable category under IIT Law Art. 2 (S09), but the underlying income (salary, property-sale gain, dividends) may carry Chinese IIT: comprehensive income 3-45%, asset transfer and dividends flat 20% (Art. 3). Actual amounts depend on facts not supplied; all CN-tax cells blank + UNVERIFIED.

flags.title: U.S. §988 exchange gain depends on basis records
flags.detail: If CNY appreciated between receipt (basis = USD value when received, S13/S16) and conversion, the personal-transaction exclusion in §988(e)(2) (S14) covers only gains of USD 200 or less per transaction; above that the full gain is ordinary income. Basis facts unknown; US-tax cells blank + UNVERIFIED.

flags.title: Wise fee is quote-time only
flags.detail: Wise publishes no fixed fee table for from-CNY transfers; exact fees appear only at transfer setup (S17). All Wise money cells blank + UNVERIFIED. Provider limits in the text are provider-published and eligible only for the provider's stated eligibility rules.

flags.title: Card issuer FX/ATM fees unverified
flags.detail: No issuer or UnionPay fee schedule was verified in this edition. Card-route cost cells blank + UNVERIFIED.

flags.title: 2004 staged-remittance schedule vs 2014 reform — conflict
flags.detail: The 2004 Interim Measures (S04 Art. 6) required emigration transfers to go out in stages (first ≤50% of the approved total; after 1 year ≤50% of the remainder; after 2 years the rest). SAFE Huifa [2014] No. 2 Section VI(2) (S03) removed the mandatory staged-remittance requirement (approved amount may be remitted once or in parts). Current local practice may still vary; confirm with the competent SAFE office before relying on one-time remittance of an entire approved amount.

flags.title: Implementing Rules Art. 39 fine clause is repealed
flags.detail: The endnote on S02 states Art. 39 (RMB 30,000/1,000 default fines) was repealed by SAFE Huifa [2023] No. 8. Earlier editions citing Art. 39 fines as current are wrong on this point; penalty framework now falls back to the Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations and other rules (not re-fetched in this edition).

flags.title: U.S. Code text currency caveat
flags.detail: uscode.house.gov displayed a temporary-format notice during retrieval (2026-11-10). The §988 text (S14) was therefore taken from GPO's official govinfo.gov compilation (2003 edition). Its amendment notes show subsection (e) last amended in 1997 (Pub. L. 105-34); no later amendments to (e) appear in that edition. Independent confirmation against the current OLRC edition should be repeated when uscode.house.gov is fully restored.

flags.title: BOC tariff note 1 permits local and contractual variation
flags.detail: The modeled 0.1% / min 50 / max 260 + 150 cable price is the published national personal e-banking schedule (S06). Note 1 of that tariff allows agreements, promotional discounts and local differences. A branch quote may differ; the model is not an executable quote.

flags.title: Institutional/trade-account pricing unverified
flags.detail: The foreign-trade settlement account (M07) and company profit route (M12) involve institutional banking relationships whose tariffs were not verified. Ladder L6 is modeled with the personal tariff purely as a comparison reference and is flagged; L10 cells are blank.

flags.title: Documentation and professional costs have no official price
flags.detail: Notarization, translation, agents, tax advisors and travel have no published national price verified here. Cells blank + UNVERIFIED. Prior editions' estimates are not reused.

flags.title: BOC 折算价 (conversion column) is not a transaction price
flags.detail: The board's 中行折算价 column (671.88 on the snapshot) is an internal conversion/accounting rate. The model uses the midpoint of spot buy/sell (667.625) as the margin reference, consistent with the board disclaimer that transaction prices are the buy/sell columns. Alternative margins computed against 折算价 would differ and are not used.

flags.title: Form 3520 (foreign gifts/bequests) not re-fetched in this edition
flags.detail: Prior editions cite a Form 3520 duty for certain foreign gifts and bequests. The IRS page was not re-retrieved in this edition's verification pass; the claim is marked unverified here and no cost/penalty figure is attached to it.

flags.title: Known-subtotal is not an all-in cost
flags.detail: Every priced ladder shows a known-cost subtotal containing only verified components (FX margin at board snapshot + BOC published handling + cable). Receiving bank, intermediary and tax components are blank. The all-in column stays blank + UNVERIFIED at every target; blank does not mean zero.
